verdict.rationale: Amplitude's docs describe official SDKs that share one API surface across web, mobile, server, and game engines, with a common identity, event, and consent model. Named React Native and Flutter SDKs, web auto-instrumentation, a server-side HTTP V2 endpoint, and a wizard that installs the right SDK back this up. Missing for 10: an explicit list of the supported backend and native languages (e.g., which server languages, iOS, Android), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the SDKs work well in practice.
